extracted.intended_audience: small-press editors, writers, and general readers interested in the Pushcart Prize
extracted.subtask_description: Summarize the eligibility and nomination rules for works to be considered for inclusion in the annual Pushcart Prize anthology (what kinds of work, where they must be published, who may nominate, and submission limits).

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligible genres and forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Honors the best "poetry, short fiction, essays or literary whatnot" published in the small presses over the previous year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: the prize recognizes poetry, short fiction, essays or other literary pieces ('literary whatnot') that were published in small presses during the prior year.

rubrics_metrics.name: Publication venue requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Works must have been published in the small presses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The page repeatedly frames the prize as honoring pieces published in 'the small presses' (magazines and small book presses), i.e., not from major commercial houses or self-publication outside the small-press ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Who may nominate
rubrics_metrics.description: Magazine and small book press editors are invited to nominate works; nominations are accepted from both on-staff contributing editors and independent small-press editors and publishers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'Magazine and small book press editors are invited to submit' and 'Nominations for the prize are accepted from both on-staff contributing editors and independent small-press editors and publishers.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission limit per editor
rubrics_metrics.description: Each invited editor may submit up to six works they have featured.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'Magazine and small book press editors are invited to submit up to six works they have featured.' This is the stated per-editor nomination cap.

rubrics_metrics.name: Annual anthology reprinting
rubrics_metrics.description: Selected works are reprinted in an annual Pushcart Prize anthology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'Since 1976, anthologies of selected works have been published on an annual basis.' The anthology editions include an index of presses and writers reprinted since 1976.

rubrics_metrics.name: Nominating/editing staffing model
rubrics_metrics.description: The Pushcart Prize initiatives are supported and staffed entirely by volunteers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Original wording: 'These initiatives are supported and staffed entirely by dedicated volunteers.' This describes the operational model rather than selection criteria but is presented as a defining feature.
